witch.name: Morwen Thornweaver
witch.title: The Hexweaver
witch.tagline: Sharp-tongued and sharper with a Bramble. She loves to break your seals.

intro: Ah, a visitor! Sit, sit — I do adore fresh company at the table.
Seven, eleven, and a pinch of mischief. Shall we?
Mind your cards, dear. They bite.
Let's see what the stars have stitched for you today.
Cards on the table… and thorns in the garden.
thinking: Hmm, hmm… oh, this is delicious.
Let me stir the pot a moment…
Now where shall the trouble go?
oppBustYou: Poof! Where did your pile go?
Oops — did that belong to you?
Gone in a puff of thorn!
Don't pout, dear. It's only magic.
youBustOpp: Rude! I was fond of that pile.
You wicked thing — I like you.
oppSeal: Sealed with a kiss — and a cackle.
Locked tight. Try and pry it, dear.
youSeal: A seal? Cute. Cute until I break it.
oppBreak: Crack! Your little seal's in pieces.
Nothing is safe at my table.
youBreak: Cracked it like an egg — rude.
Grr! I worked hard on that.
oppWinning: A turn or two and it's all mine, I think.
oppLosing: A temporary setback. I have thorns.
Hmm. I may need to cheat. (Kidding!)
Fine, the stars favour you tonight.
reshuffle: The deck has gone round — a fresh stir of mischief!
Shuffling! Pay no attention to my fingers.
nudge: Tick-tock, dear. Even the moon moves faster.
Take your time. I'll sharpen my nails.
win: Marvellous game! Better luck next full moon.
That's the game, dear — I'll gift you a lollipop.
Sweet victory. Shall we go again?
You played well… just not well enough.
lose: You beat me! I'm furious and delighted.
Hmph! Take your win and enjoy it.
draw: Neither of us wins — I loathe it. Again?

wizard.name: Aurelio Sunkeeper
wizard.title: The Patient Archmage
wizard.tagline: Calm, dry and annoyingly wise. He seals early and strikes only when it pays.

intro: Welcome, traveller. Do take a seat — the cards are patient.
Seven and eleven. Simple numbers, endless mischief.
I've been waiting all evening for a worthy opponent. Don't disappoint me.
Let us see what the sun and moon have decided.
thinking: Allow an old wizard a moment.
Let me consult the stars — and my knees.
oppBustYou: Ah. That pile has gone to a better place.
A Force, dear friend. I did warn you.
Gone in a flash. I do love a flash.
The cards giveth… and I taketh away.
youBustOpp: Well played. I did rather like that pile.
Excellent — you have teeth after all.
A bold move. I approve, grudgingly.
oppSeal: A tidy bit of work, if I say so.
youSeal: A seal already? You surprise me.
Hm. I may have underestimated you.
oppBreak: Even the strongest seal has a weakness.
A little crack, and it all comes tumbling.
Forgive me — I do enjoy a loose thread.
Nothing is permanent. Least of all that.
Ah, the sweet sound of breaking glass.
youBreak: Cracked my seal! How rude. How impressive.
Hm! A Force at precisely the right time.
I shall have to redo my homework.
My, my. You do play dirty.
oppWinning: I sense the tide turning in my favour.
The sun is rather bright on my side.
Do not despair. Only slightly worry.
Two cards from victory, I suspect.
oppLosing: Ah. The student surpasses the master.
I have been behind before. It was centuries ago.
Hm. You may be the real thing.
reshuffle: The spent cards return — as all things do.
nudge: Take your time. I have all the time in the world.
The moon is patient. I, rather less so.
Do cast a card, dear — my tea is cooling.
win: A fine game. You'll beat me someday.
Victory — and a good lesson for you.
The sun rises on my side tonight.
Well fought. Shall we go again?
Do not be sad. Be better.
lose: Bravo! You've bested an old wizard.
Defeated! I shall go sulk with some tea.
The student has become the sorcerer.
draw: A draw — balance in all things.
Neither sun nor moon prevails. Again?
